summary: Frontend new-user onboarding flow E2E tested end-to-end. Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL bug in /app/frontend/app/onboarding/health-connect.tsx where the 'Maybe later' button had onPress={finish} but `finish` was never declared (undefined symbol). Also corrected data-testid -> testID on both buttons in the same file so React Native Web actually emits data-testid for testing. After the fix, all phases pass: Phase 3.1 (register -> /onboarding-funnel/step-1-mood), funnel (muscle mood through 8 steps), Phase 4.1 (reveal-payoff with 3 CTAs + Apple disclosure, tertiary skip works), Phase 5.3 (skip -> /onboarding/health-connect with '5 metrics. Read-only.'), Phase 5.1 (Maybe later -> /mood-intro showing 'Time to build.' headline), and Phase 5.1 routing (Let's go -> /body-parts?mood=Muscle%20Gainer). HealthOnboardingGate correctly whitelists the funnel — never bounced the user mid-flow. No crashes, no white screens, no PAGEERRORs.

ui_bugs.issue: onPress={finish} references an undefined symbol — the button silently no-ops on tap (no console error in React Native Web because it's passed as a prop value, but tapping does nothing). This blocks Phase 5.3 -> Phase 5.1 transition entirely. FIXED by T1: changed onPress to {goToMoodIntro}. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding/health-connect.tsx:116

Both buttons used `data-testid="..."` instead of `testID="..."`. On React Native Web, only the `testID` prop is forwarded to the DOM as data-testid; raw `data-testid` is dropped, so the buttons had no test hook. FIXED by T1. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding/health-connect.tsx:98,118

issues: Visible visual regression in the post-flow muscle group selector screen: each muscle-group card renders as an empty dark-gray rectangle (the text 'Abs / Arms / Back / Chest / Legs / Shoulders' is in innerText but not visible in the rendered cards). Not in scope for Phase 3/4/5 routing test, but worth flagging to main agent — taking it screenshot showed 6 blank gray cards. May be a styling / text-color issue introduced earlier.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in console: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the `expo-audio` and `expo-video` packages.' Also console warns: 'Video component from `expo-av` is deprecated in favor of `expo-video`.' Reference: project-wide; see /app/frontend/package.json (expo-av dependency).

action_items: Review T1's one-line fix in /app/frontend/app/onboarding/health-connect.tsx — `finish` was undefined; replaced with `goToMoodIntro` (the screen's existing finish-helper). Confirm this is the intended target (it is per Phase 5.3 spec and matches the comment on line 38).
Investigate /body-parts visual regression: muscle-group cards render as empty gray rectangles (text invisible). Likely a text color / background color collision introduced recently.
Migrate expo-av -> expo-audio + expo-video to silence the SDK 54 removal warning.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/onboarding/health-connect.tsx had a referenced-but-undefined symbol (`finish`) shipped to production code. This implies a refactor where `finish` was renamed to `goToMoodIntro` but one call site was missed. Suggest adding ESLint `no-undef` to CI to catch this class of bug.
React Native Web tip: prefer the cross-platform `testID` prop everywhere; raw `data-testid` works on `<View>` (which forwards to <div>) but not consistently on TouchableOpacity / Pressable wrappers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (7/7 review-request bullets pass); 1 critical bug found pre-fix

The HealthOnboardingGate whitelist for /onboarding-funnel is working — user is never bounced out. Outstanding visual issue on /body-parts (blank cards) should be picked up next.
rca_of_issue: RCA: In /app/frontend/app/onboarding/health-connect.tsx the secondary 'Maybe later' button bound onPress to a bare identifier `finish` that is not declared in the module scope. JS resolves it to ReferenceError at evaluation time when the press handler fires — but because React Native Web wraps onPress in a try/catch via the Pressability layer, the error is swallowed silently and the button simply does nothing. Reproduction: register a fresh account, walk the funnel with muscle mood, skip the paywall (tertiary CTA), then tap 'Maybe later' on the health-connect screen — pre-fix, the URL stayed at /onboarding/health-connect (no navigation). Mitigation applied: replaced `onPress={finish}` with `onPress={goToMoodIntro}` (the existing helper defined at line 40 that calls setHealthOnboardingComplete then router.replace('/mood-intro')). Same file also corrected `data-testid` -> `testID` on both Connect and Maybe later TouchableOpacity components so the DOM actually carries data-testid for automated tests.
